data.narrative:
FuriosaAI is a Series C semiconductor company founded by June Paik that has raised $246M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 same-stage private peers in Chips & Semiconductors (Etched, d-Matrix, DEEPX) and 3 public semiconductor benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $246M total raised proxy, yielding $418M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables yields $2.0B, with the comp set ranging from $529M (DEEPX) to $5.0B (Etched). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 21.5x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of revenue disclosure, common among private companies.

The two applicable methods support a triangulated range of $355M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.2B. The wide dispersion—reflecting heterogeneity in peer maturity, capital efficiency, and market positioning—suggests material uncertainty around near-term valuation. Stage-progression produces the conservative bound; peer median anchors the middle; and the high end reflects outlier peer valuations. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to capital deployment and competitive positioning within the frontier chip architecture segment.
